verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents payments as a core platform capability, a PayPal app to 'charge for your bookings', and BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED and BOOKING_PAID webhook triggers, so charging at booking time is clearly a product feature. A community comment complaining about being 'forced to use Stripe' also indirectly confirms Stripe-based booking payment. Missing for 10: first-party Stripe app or setup documentation, docs on setting a price per event type and requiring payment before the booking is confirmed, and hands-on corroboration of the checkout flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can collect payment (e.g. via Stripe) at the moment of booking for paid sessions
